text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this rice is piping hot! ♪ How
deliciously
marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But wait, how does the rice keep so
moist?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know! It stays nice and moist because
of all the
steam gushing through!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ☆ I see it now, it's the steam!
Very
marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Steamy, steamy water vapor! ☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look! I've found some pussy
willow! ☆ Is it a
cat? Or a willow?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know!
It's gotta be a willow that's like a
cat. ♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ☆ Looking at it up close, the
buds do kind
of look like bushy cat tails!
How extraordinarily
marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Fluffy, floofy pussy willow! ☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaaa!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so many grown-ups! ☆ But why are
they in
such a hurry?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know! They must be super busy
working! ♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Really?! How hardworking can they be?
That's so
marvelous of them! ☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Thanks for aaall that you do! ☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Keep it up, but don't tire yourself out! ♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And now we're back where we
started—Tracen
Academy! Where we run
round and round every
day! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hm, but why do we Umamusume run? Is
there a
reason behind it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, that's because... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! It's because there's no end
to running!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There's no end?! Oh, like how the world
is round!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The world is marvelous and endless! ☆
Wherever
we go, there's always more to
come! ★

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
The world goes round and round! ☆
Today and
tomorrow too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look at them, they've finally discovered
how
boundless the world is.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, being so young, they'll hardly
slow down.
At their age, they're
invincible. ♪
